recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a future DeviceDefinition implementation identifies a concrete missing UsageContext type or value, file a new scoped Jira/terminology change with the proposed code and rationale.
issue_request: FHIR-48436 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification OO change request for R6 asking to update or review UsageContext value sets to support DeviceDefinition uses. The accepted resolution was to identify any additional UsageContext values and, only if any were established, submit a follow-up terminology/core Jira.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-48436 was found. Earlier DeviceDefinition work already introduced the current usages: FHIR-29728 added DeviceDefinition.guideline.useContext, FHIR-30504 added DeviceDefinition.chargeItem.useContext, and FHIR-42900/related canonical-resource work added DeviceDefinition.useContext.
additional_context: Later Jira comments and DEV/OO minutes state that no obvious additions were found, no additional codes were identified, no values were needed, and no changes were required. DeviceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini, and the UsageContext datatype uses extensible/example bindings rather than a closed value list.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Adding new core value-set content would contradict the post-resolution DEV/OO review, and no source edit is needed for DeviceDefinition to use UsageContext.

related_jiras.note: Published DeviceDefinition guideline work introduced DeviceDefinition.guideline.useContext, one of the usages reviewed by FHIR-48436.
Published DeviceDefinition charge item work introduced DeviceDefinition.chargeItem.useContext, another usage reviewed by FHIR-48436.
Canonical-resource work added top-level DeviceDefinition.useContext; it explained current source context but was not separately decided here.
Related DeviceDefinition definitional-modeling issue points to FHIR-42900 and was context only, not a separate reconciliation decision.
